entries.title: Job 29:1
segments: And Job continued the lifting up of his speech, and said,

entries.title: Job 29:2
segments: Oh that I were as [in] months past, as [in] the days when God watched over me;

entries.title: Job 29:3
segments: when His lamp shone on my head; I walked [through] darkness by His light;

entries.title: Job 29:4
segments: as I was in the days of my harvest, when the secret of God [was] on my tent;

entries.title: Job 29:5
segments: When the Almighty [was] yet with me, [and] my children were around me;

entries.title: Job 29:6
segments: when I washed my steps with curds, and the rock poured out rivers of oil for me;

entries.title: Job 29:7
segments: when I went out to the gate by the city; [when] I prepared my seat in the street!

entries.title: Job 29:8
segments: The young men saw me and hid themselves; and the aged arose [and] stood up.

entries.title: Job 29:9
segments: The rulers held back from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

entries.title: Job 29:10
segments: The noble's voice was subdued, and their tongue clung to the roof of their mouth.

entries.title: Job 29:11
segments: For the ear heard and blessed me. And the eye saw me and witnessed to me.

entries.title: Job 29:12
segments: For I delivered the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who [had] none to help him.

entries.title: Job 29:13
segments: The blessing of the perishing came on me; and I caused the widow's heart to sing.

entries.title: Job 29:14
segments: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my judgment [was] like a robe and a diadem.

entries.title: Job 29:15
segments: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

entries.title: Job 29:16
segments: I [was] a father to the poor; and the cause which I did not know, I searched out.

entries.title: Job 29:17
segments: I broke the fangs of the wicked, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

entries.title: Job 29:18
segments: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply [my] days like the sand.

entries.title: Job 29:19
segments: My root [was] open to the waters, and the dew lay all night on my branch.

entries.title: Job 29:20
segments: My glory [was] fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

entries.title: Job 29:21
segments: They listened to me, and waited, and kept silent at my counsel.

entries.title: Job 29:22
segments: After my words they did not go on; and my speech dropped on them.

entries.title: Job 29:23
segments: And they waited for me like the rain; and they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.

entries.title: Job 29:24
segments: I smiled kindly on them [when] they did not believe; and they did not make the light of my face fall.

entries.title: Job 29:25
segments: I chose out their way, and sat as chief; and I lived like a king in the army, as one [who] comforts the mourners.
